cl.x: Provide SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 01.02).
SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish is a powder concentrate to be added to the wash water after grouting tiles with epoxy resin. It removes residual epoxy grout haze.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish is used as an added cleaning solution added to the wash water when using epoxy grouting.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Storage conditions
cl.x: The Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between 0 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to the packaging. Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

s: Mixing ratio: 1 : 100; Add approximately 50grams per 5 Litres of clean water.
r: 1 : 100; Add approximately 50grams per 5 Litres of clean water.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Yield
cl.x: 75–150 m² per container; Note: Consumption data is theoretical and does not allow for any additional material due to surface porosity, surface profile, variations in level, wastage or any other variations.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Equipment
s: Sponge float
Bucket with rollers
Grout finishing tool

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Mixing
cl.x: 1. Follow the mixing ratio of 1 : 100, for example, 50 g of Product to 5 litres of water. 2. Measure out the SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish and pour into a bucket of clean water. 3. Stir manually using a clean tool.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Important
s: Risk of staining on natural stone
Using the Product on natural stone may result in surface staining. 1. Do not use the Product in combination with natural stone. 2. Apply on a test area if in doubt.
Protect the Product from moisture
Note: 1. Reseal open containers.
Preconditions

Observe information such as waiting times in the Product Data Sheet of the joint grouting product. 1. Use a sponge float to wash the surface of the tiles. 2. IMPORTANT Rinse the sponge and change the wash water frequently. Remove any smears or remaining haze. 3. Allow the surface to dry. 4. Repeat the cleaning process if there is any remaining epoxy grout haze.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically.

Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
